IMP MAXIMINVS PIVS AVG ; PROVIDENTIA AVG

A corroded and complete Roman silver denarius of Maximinus I (235-238 AD) dating to the period AD 235 to 236. The obverse depicts a laureate and draped bust facing right; legend reads: IMP MAXIMINVS PIVS AVG.
